The checks are unchanged. Same shape as the phase-12 pilot's c6 correction ('against a real supervisor' for a command family with no supervisor path). Scope recorded so the tick is not read wider: only `status`/`cancel` have published schemas anywhere in @crabgic/contracts/@crabgic/supervisor; `evidence`/`doctor`/`NOT_IMPLEMENTED` are shapes this phase owns, and criterion 7 is where their conformance mechanism is (and is left unticked).

The vacuity measurements that make the 32 new cases evidence rather than decoration. Four production mutations on shapes this criterion names — an extra key on every doctor finding, a reversed finding order on the --json render path only, two reworded repairStep strings, and an added key on `learn list --json` — each left packages/cli COMPLETELY GREEN at 100 files and 1175 tests before the work (V1-V4), and each reddens after it (P1a-P1d). The named expected-green control is `learn-command-backend.test.ts`, whose toMatchObject passes for an extra-keyed payload where the snapshot cannot, and that difference IS the value the snapshot adds. Section 3 records the only red run a snapshot suite can have, 32 failed of 46 under CI=true before generation. Sections 4 and 9 record the normalizer review that caught two defects the green run did not, and a dated correction to that section's own units. Section 7 states the three narrowings verbatim; section 8 records the line drift this change caused.

criteria.notes: Original, not drift: `git show d0f29c8:packages/cli/src/commands/__snapshots__/cli.snapshots.test.ts.snap` (this phase's own landing commit) carries the same three non-help entries and no others. Not a wording case: removing 'every' would delete a guarantee rather than clarify a claim, which the wording protocol forbids. Adjacent non-snapshot pins that limit the blast radius are enumerated in the defect (status/cancel are validated against 05's published zod schemas, which is stronger than a snapshot; evidence --json has an exact toEqual for the empty report; doctor --json has only a finding COUNT, which two of the last three merges already moved). **Remediated 2026-08-07 (closeout batch G).** PR #115 took this record's own S-sized remedy: 19 snapshot entries to 51, covering all 22 ParsedCommand members that extend JsonFlag. THE THREE NARROWINGS ARE DISCLOSED RATHER THAN ABSORBED, and they are stated verbatim in the roadmap annotation, with one declared deviation: whitespace is normalized and the transcript's line-wrap hyphen in approved-and-dispatched is closed up. Re-checked mechanically against the committed transcript — everything else in all three is verbatim. (i) `run --json` is ONE payload shape whose two unsnapshotted content arms produce the identical field set to the snapshotted escalate arm; (ii) `status --watch --json` is byte-produced by the same formatJson expression as the snapshotted non-watch branch; (iii) `status <run-id> --json` for an unknown run serializes to an empty object, so the populated RunStatusResult shape is pinned by a zod parse in cli.commands.schema.test rather than by a snapshot in the suite this criterion names. THE JUDGEMENT CALL ON (iii), made in this pass rather than inherited: it is the one narrowing whose pin sits OUTSIDE the named suite, and the box is ticked anyway on this repository's own precedent — roadmap/06 criteria 6 and 9 were kept ticked when their named suites were measured not to carry them, because the guarantee was met and only the pointer was off, with the pointer gap recorded and later closed by adding cases to the named suite. RESIDUAL, named so it cannot drift: no case in cli.snapshots.test snapshots a POPULATED RunStatusResult, and closing that is one S-sized case. TWO CORRECTIONS TO THIS RECORD'S OWN EARLIER TEXT, both measured. The id-set rider's stated justification is already discharged AT THE BUILDER by run-doctor.test.ts:17-31, which asserts the exact ordered id list against buildDefaultDoctorChecks; what was genuinely unpinned is the ids as rendered through the doctor --json DISPATCH path, which is what the shipped assertion pins. And the 8-check default-set comment this record listed as owed was already corrected on main by PR #66, so it is no work item and the credit is not this wave's. Corrected 2026-08-07 after review, and measured rather than re-reasoned. This sentence previously attributed the populated-shape pin to `cli.commands.schema.test.ts`'s `RunStatusResultSchema.parse`. That attribution was FALSE and the review was right: that case dispatches `status` for a UUID against an empty `createRunsRegistry()`, so the payload it parses is `{}` — the very thin payload narrowing (iii) discloses — and `z.object({ run: RunRecordSchema.optional() }).strict()` accepts `{}` whatever its members are called. Probe, with a COMPILING mutation so nothing measured stale `dist/` (`npm run build` exit 0): tightening `RunRecordSchema.updatedAt` so a populated record fails its parse reddens 4 of 1574 — `build-router.test.ts`'s populated `run.status` case, both `compose-supervisor.test.ts` recovery cases and the concurrent `uds-server` case — while `cli.commands.schema.test.ts` stays GREEN. That asymmetry is what proves the old attribution vacuous and the new one load-bearing, and it also shows the wrap fires on the production dispatch path rather than only in a test. Restored by explicit source and path; md5 back to baseline, 1574 tests back, `git status` clean.
